headline: Proposed ordinances for an Assistant Director of Personnel and a Manager of Financial and Administrative Services, plus board appointments.
summary: Mayor Brian A. DePeña has named two people to the Lawrence Cultural Council. Several older items, some from 2020, were tabled and are listed again.
items: Appointment of Leonardo G. Mirabel to the Lawrence Cultural Council (448/26)
Appointment of Cristian M. Martinez to the Lawrence Cultural Council (449/26)
Creation of ordinance for Assistant Director of Personnel (415/26), tabled from October 6, 2026
Appointment of Miguel B. Aguilo to the Zoning Board of Appeals (252/26), tabled from June 2, 2026
Confirmation of Kervin Valdez to the Airport Commission (041/26), tabled from February 3, 2026
Proposed new ordinance for Manager of Financial and Administrative Services (323/24), tabled from September 17, 2024
Report on Board and Commissions (49/20), tabled from February 18, 2020
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
